description: Total of revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value
